stem: Display gets €45,000 under first click and €18,000 under last click. The display manager says this proves display drives €45,000 of sales. What is the soundest reply?

options.text: First click is the true figure, since it credits the touch that began each journey
Last click is the true figure, since it credits the touch nearest to each order
Both are rules for sharing credit; only an experiment shows what display adds
The true figure is the average of the two models, which is €31,500
